scope: One native block read at address70/register00; strict length4 and terminal/final status; no encoder configuration

source_protocol.license: GPL-2.0-or-later; new assembly retains this license

read_rules: Unchanged current kernel HDMI/NTSC/720p/64MiB and framebuffer/memory admission, native CPU and PCI/mapping gates
Current native entry status must have no busy0800 or terminal0036; CF8 is restored
One command,100000polls maximum; completion plus error rejects
Only pure done reads16-bit length atC006; must equal4 before any FIFO access
Exactly four8-bit reads atC009, assembled in wire order low byte first
Acknowledge only observed owned terminal0036 once; final busy/terminal flags reject
Timeout never acknowledges, resets or retries; late final status remains retained
Any32-bit payload accepted as raw data when protocol succeeds, not treated as a unique ID

result_codes.1: green protocol success; raw value unrestricted

display: Ten MSB-left rows atx128/y200+48r with24x24cells and32px pitch: PCI ID, command/status, BAR, entry, last poll, raw data, final status, result, polls, block length. Independent handoff green bar unchanged.
limits: Bounded software polls do not guarantee hardware IO-cycle or kernel API wall time
PC CPU fixtures reach actual wrong-PCI refusal; transaction ports are tested with synthetic IO values separately
Current probe does not independently reread EEPROM configuration or cable in native context; current kernel platform eligibility retained; no mode/encoder writes
Native raw values are display/RAM only; persisted CPU context is pre-file-write
No Windows1.6, unique encoder identity, full native display initialization or historical boot-fix claim
